tagline: Futures trade journal and prop-firm rule tracker
brief: A self-hosted journal for futures traders on prop-firm accounts: log trades, track drawdown and payout rules. It should feel disciplined and precise, like a ledger, not flashy like a trading app.
criteria: Success: has both letters T and C, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, distinct from candlestick-chart marks.

concepts.name: Boundary C
concepts.idea: A T held inside a C: the trader inside the rule boundary, with the opening as the breach point.
rationale: Both letters of the name: T and C. The uppercase, tracked wordmark carries the same blocky weight as the T
The T sits exactly centred with 28 units on every side, equal to the ring's own thickness
Single-colour outline geometry on a 16-unit grid; a heavier small-size cut is used for favicons
Deliberately avoids the candlestick and chart-arrow clichés of trading apps

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup in the app header and the small-cut symbol on a violet tile as the favicon and app icon.
